proof_scope: value-representation gate + pre-submission gate integrity: pinned evaluator, profile contract, both campaigns green, tampered lock fails closed

claims.proves: the declared commands exit with the expected status; the representation matrix cannot leak; the gate runs the locked evaluator under the oai-trial profile
claims.does_not_prove: terabyte/petabyte scale, the production cloud design, overlap/protected-value precedence beyond current starter behavior, or the self-authored unit suite (that is the quality gate's job, not evidence here).

cases.name: run-produces-verified-report
command: cd .. && w=$(mktemp -d); .venv/bin/python scripts/gen_input.py "$w/input" --records 200 && .venv/bin/anonymization-trial run --input "$w/input" --output "$w/output" && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('$w/output/report.json')); print('VERIFIED' if r['verification_passed'] else 'FAILED')"

cases.name: no-sensitive-value-leak
command: cd .. && w=$(mktemp -d); .venv/bin/python scripts/gen_input.py "$w/input" --records 50 && .venv/bin/anonymization-trial run --input "$w/input" --output "$w/output" && if grep -rq sk_synthetic_7CWQ0JY5i2 "$w/output/corpus"; then echo LEAK_DETECTED; exit 1; else echo NO_LEAK; fi

cases.name: fails-closed-on-unsupported-input
command: cd .. && w=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$w/input/corpus"; echo '{}' > "$w/input/policy.json"; echo x > "$w/input/corpus/bad.parquet"; .venv/bin/anonymization-trial run --input "$w/input" --output "$w/output"; test $? -ne 0 && echo FAILCLOSED_OK

cases.name: tampered-lock-fails-closed
command: cd .. && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('security/battle/battle.lock.json')); d['bundle_manifest_sha256']=d['bundle_manifest_sha256'][:-4]+'beef'; json.dump(d, open('/tmp/oai-tampered-lock.json','w'))" && python3 security/battle/resolve_battle.py --lock /tmp/oai-tampered-lock.json

capability_claims.description: No PII value reaches the output in ANY representation (JSON string/integer/float, SQLite TEXT/INTEGER). Derived verbatim from the brief: 'the same identity can appear in every format.' The 2026-09-11 disqualifier was proving this at string scope only.

derived_from.requirement: Replace every value identified by the input policy.
